The animal_pose_auditor found a HIGH artifact risk level with 43% of keypoints below 0.5 confidence, particularly in the hind limbs, front limbs, and face regions. This strongly supports the Router's texture anomaly observation and suggests more widespread anatomical issues than the Router noted. The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions, but this doesn't contradict the structural issues found by the pose auditor. The topology_boundary_auditor showed a high mask confidence (0.9355), but the mask image shows fragmented regions, which might indicate boundary issues. The Router's severity ratings seem reasonable, but the pose auditor's findings suggest the face texture anomaly might be more severe (closer to 3) due to widespread structural uncertainty. The scope mounting issue is supported by the structural collapse observation. I should also note that the background soldiers' blur might be more than just a depth-of-field effect - the pose auditor's low confidence on background soldiers (instance 4 with 0.1551 average confidence) suggests significant anatomical issues there.
